meta: Write a bilingual Vietnamese-English CV with AI: sending the same CV to every job gets it rejected in seconds.

muc.title: One CV for every job
muc.text: Sending the same CV to every job is the mistake that gets applications rejected within seconds.

muc.title: Pull out the keywords
muc.text: Paste the job ad into a chatbot and ask it to pull out the five most mentioned skills.

muc.title: Tailor the CV to the role
muc.text: Paste your CV with your phone number and home address removed, and ask AI which experience to move to the top.

muc.title: A natural English version
muc.text: Ask AI to write the English version the way a native speaker would, then check every number and don't let AI add work you didn't do.

muc.title: Compare CV and one ad
muc.text: Pick a job ad you like, ask AI to compare it with your CV and name the first three things to fix.
